scope: in-scope personas only (Service Co, Super Admin, Admin, Front/SaasFront/Auth). Product Co + Staffing Co are dormant.

mysql.note: config/database.php read/write split with sticky=true — after a write in the same request, all subsequent reads hit primary to avoid replica lag reading just-written rows.

app.topology: 1× 32 GB VM start; add 2nd VM behind load balancer in Phase 7 only if k6 baseline shows saturation
app.vms_to_throughput_math: 1× 32 GB VM ≈ 16 workers @ 100 ms sync ≈ 160 req/sec on its own; CDN absorbs 70–90% of public traffic so effective app-tier load at 10K concurrent is much lower than raw 10K RPS
app.static_memoization: forbidden — use Redis per-tenant key (tenant:{id}:key) instead; if unavoidable, register Octane::prepareApplicationForNextOperation to flush between requests

redis.topology: two-instances (different ports), even on same host

redis_cache.purpose: ES request cache + dashboard metrics + smtp_settings + tenant_config
redis_cache.invalidation_strategy: prefix-version (tenant:{id}:v{n} + Cache::increment on write). NOT Redis tags (cluster-unsafe, O(N)).

service_job_application_stage_submit.read_after_write: client uses optimistic local cache injection; ES read with lastWriteAt < 2s guard prefers local store

service_job_application_status_update.read_after_write: optimistic local cache injection + 422 rollback via Metronic toast

service_apptracker_store_bulk.bulk_insert: explicit Bulk Action class (BulkCandidateImportAction) generates UUIDs + timestamps, Model::insert(), then dispatches Elastic*IndexBulkJob. Never bypasses Observers via DB::table()->insert().

cache.invalidation: prefix-version (global scope, increment on any company write)

auth_login.max_query_target: bulk fetch (user + roles + permissions + company) in 1 round-trip via eager load + session cache

client_side_patterns.optimistic_rollback_envelope: every optimistic write wraps in optimistic-apply → POST → 200 keep / 422 rollback + Metronic toast / network-error retry-queue (max 3) → final failure toast. Implemented in resources/js/lib/optimistic.js.

read_after_write_strategy.single_entity_redirects: load view payload from write-return value or MySQL point-lookup by primary key (source of truth). NOT from ES.
read_after_write_strategy.list_views: optimistic local cache injection — Add/Edit/Submit response includes new/updated ID; client patches local store before any ES fetch.
read_after_write_strategy.stale_read_guard: client store tracks lastWriteAt; any ES read payload older than < 2s of last write is ignored in favor of local store.

queue_dispatch_rules.after_commit: all indexing/mail/broadcast jobs dispatched inside DB::transaction() MUST declare `public bool $afterCommit = true;`. Direct event() calls inside transactions MUST be wrapped in DB::afterCommit().

dashboard_counters.pattern: Redis HINCRBY via Observer events (e.g. JobApplicationObserver::created → HINCRBY tenant:{id}:metrics open_jobs 1).
dashboard_counters.reconciliation: nightly command uses ES search_after + MySQL Model::cursor() in 2000-row chunks to true-up drift; never load full ID lists.

regression_tests.slim_source_guard: tests/Feature/RenderViewTest.php renders each top-30 view and asserts every column referenced in Blade exists in the slim _source payload. Fails CI if a view references a column not in the whitelist.

es_refresh_discipline.bulk_api_threshold: any > 1 record index path uses _bulk API
es_refresh_discipline.lint_guard: scripts/ai-guards.sh GUARD 4 — broadened to ban both 'refresh' => true AND 'refresh' => 'wait_for' outside allowlist

es_zero_sync_lookup_in_write_paths.rule: no sync elasticService->getClient()->exists() or ->get() in the request path of a write endpoint. MySQL is write authority; ES update is async (after_commit dispatch); read-back is from PHP memory or MySQL point-lookup.
verified_violations: app/Http/Controllers/ServiceCompany/ServiceCompanyJobApplicationController.php::SlotsUpdate (3 sync roundtrips: exists → update with refresh:true → get)

covering_indexes_ddl.note: schema lives in database/schema/mysql-schema.sql (CLAUDE.md rule 2); these ALTERs are appended there, not as migrations.
covering_indexes_ddl.note_add_job_wise_condidates_has_no_dele: verified — reviewer's DDL omitted this; do NOT include deleted_at in the index

octane_dangling_transaction_guard.rule: register App\Octane\DanglingTransactionGuard listener on OperationTerminated event. If DB::transactionLevel() > 0 at request end, issue DB::rollBack() per level + log warning with tenant_id.
octane_dangling_transaction_guard.config_octane_current_state: config/octane.php:108 — DisconnectFromDatabases + CollectGarbage are commented out. DanglingTransactionGuard added alongside existing FlushOnce + FlushTemporaryContainerInstances.
octane_dangling_transaction_guard.tenant_data_leak_risk_if_unguarded: high at 10K concurrent — dirty connection reuse can leak across tenants

tenant_cache_helper.complexity: O(1) on invalidation regardless of cache size

phase_0_baseline_protocol.run_k6: tests/load/k6/perf-10k.js against current staging with no code changes
capture_metrics: saturation point (RPS at which p95 > 2× SLO)
Horizon queue depths under 1K RPS sustained
ES took avg + MySQL slow log count > 50 ms
Redis hit rate + memory growth over 30 min
Octane worker memory + request count per worker
phase_0_baseline_protocol.acceptance_gate_for_phase_1: every Phase 1 fix must move at least one route's p95 by ≥ 10% vs baseline, or be justified as 'no regression'

phase_estimates_dev_days.notes: Phase 0 is NEW (baseline + APM + k6 baseline capture — runs BEFORE Phase 1). Phase 1 grew from 3→5 (5-queue split + read replica + APM config + ProxySQL is 5–6 days). Phase 7 conditional: 2nd app VM only if Phase 0 baseline shows single-VM saturation. Worst case 49 days; honest budget 42 days.
